concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-transaction-rules]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured limited-pilot Payout Service-path rule guide for scoped blocklist/velocity/bypass evaluation and hard-block decline evidence; rule decision and authorised-limit accounting are not booked payout or recipient proof.
warnings: The page discusses bank/card payouts but says third-party request type bankTransfer; do not infer separate card-rule type or enabled card coverage. Bypass skips a named rule, not every rule; only hardBlock is selectable. Pilot availability is unproven for a given platform.
